segments.text: 16 Sadrach, Meſach, and Abednego aunſwered and ſayd to the kyng: O Nebuchadnezer, we are not carefull to aunſwere thee in this matter.
17 Behold, our God whom we ſerue, is able to deliuer vs from the hoate fiery fornace, and hee will deliuer vs out of thy hand, O kyng.
18 But if not, be it knowne to thee O king, that we will not ſerue thy Gods, nor worſhyp the golden Image which thou haſt ſet vp.
